Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Stephen Kay's nationality is solely "American" based on the description "New Zealand-born American," without fully considering or clarifying whether this dual reference indicates only American nationality or dual nationality (New Zealand and American). This misinterpretation led to the incorrect assertion that both directors (Howard Hawks and Stephen Kay) share the same nationality when in fact, Stephen Kay's primary nationality is New Zealander, and he is not solely American. This error directly resulted in the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
